how_autopilot.upgrade_desc: The Starter Plan includes limited AI access and supports up to 2 bookings per listing. To unlock advanced AI features, higher booking capacity, automated guest communication, dynamic pricing, and full-scale hosting tools, upgrade to the AI Suite plan for a complete smart hosting experience.
